_help: One entry per standard. Each item: nums (item numbers), title, due (checklist month), status (not-started | in-progress | submitted | met | needs-correction), points/maxPoints (fill in from the rubric when known), requirements (what reviewers check), evidence (files/links), tables (ids from tables.json), feedback (consultant comments). See README for details.

items.title: Course Syllabi
items.scope: One per course (not per teacher), all 1st-semester courses.
requirements: Class grading scale (Classwork = %, Tests = %, etc.) or points
Career opportunities related to the course
End of Pathway Assessment (EOPA) for the pathway

items.title: Pacing Guides
items.scope: One per course, 1st semester. Must be current (no outdated guides).
requirements: FBLA integration: at least 3 planned FBLA activities listed

items.title: FBLA Student Activities
items.scope: Every course/period, all students, 1st semester only. 3 activities = 1 pt; 4 or more = 2 pts.
requirements: Graded classroom activity (not an FBLA community service activity)
1 graded student sample with teacher feedback
If a rubric is used: rubric included in the assignment sheet; grade and feedback written on the rubric
All students in the class complete it (printed version for students without online access)

items.title: Short-Term Projects
items.scope: 2 projects per course/period, each at least 90 minutes. Must relate to the course; not a daily-grade activity.
requirements: Minimum class hours (90 minutes or more)
1 student sample with graded rubric (score and teacher feedback on the rubric)

items.title: Long-Term Team Application Project
items.scope: One per pathway, 10+ hours, taught in a 2nd or 3rd level course. Minimum 3 interdependent students. Simulates actual business activities.
requirements: IC consultant approval of the instruction sheet
At least 1 team work sample with graded rubric (score and teacher commentary)
Pictures and sample work with teacher feedback throughout
Updated monthly with progress to date

items.title: On-Site Long-Term Project Presentation
items.scope: 3 to 5 students present at the on-site visit. Professional dress, multimedia.
requirements: Knowledge and skills applied and learned
Example(s) of the final project (not the main focus)
Practice sessions scheduled before the visit

items.title: School Demographics
items.scope: Get from guidance. Present as charts.

items.title: Program Offerings, Pathway Completers & Credentials
items.scope: Previous year and current year. Current-year completers may be predicted (mark with *).
requirements: Industry-recognized credentials (EOPA) attempted / earned per pathway

items.title: Program Recruitment Practices
items.scope: Mission statement and pathways are shown on the Program page; publicity evidence goes here.
requirements: Involvement and outreach with local organizations
Evidence of publicity (newspapers, school website, newsletters, displays, open house, middle school tours, Chamber, Rotary, SHRM)

evidence.title: Program page: pathways, courses, careers, and district programs
evidence.caption: Mission statement and FBLA recruitment details still to be added.

items.title: Teacher Certification
items.scope: Clear, renewable certificate in Business Education and/or Computer Science for every BCS teacher. CS course teachers need CS certification. Program score = lowest tier among its teachers.
requirements: Copy of teaching certificate for each BCS teacher
5 pts full certification; 3 pts working toward; 1 pt waiver/adjunct; 0 pts non-certified

items.title: Daily Schedules & Responsibilities
items.scope: Per teacher, 1st and 2nd semester.
requirements: Other school duties (department chair, club sponsor, coach, leadership)
Statement that all teachers work with FBLA

items.title: Teacher Professional Affiliations
items.scope: Copy of current membership card or letter with membership date visible. A chart alone does not count.
requirements: ACTE / GACTE / GBEA membership for every teacher in the program
Membership dates visible and current through the on-site visit

items.title: Teacher Professional Development
items.scope: 20 hours per teacher related to BCS standards. 8 of the 20 must be a job shadow at a company (not a school), a different company per teacher.
requirements: Certificates plus CTEARN screenshot showing hours
Not collaboration, team, or planning meetings
Job shadow letter on company letterhead, signed and dated by the employee shadowed

items.title: Teacher Presentation at On-Site Visit
items.scope: Showcases the entire program. All teachers participate, professional dress.

items.title: Chamber of Commerce Events (Bonus)
items.scope: 1 pt per event, max 2.
requirements: Picture of sign-in sheet with teacher signature/initials
Sign-in sheet shows event name, date, and time

items.title: Advisory Committee Composition
items.scope: At least 51% from business and industry related to BCS. Officers marked on the roster.
requirements: At least 1 business/industry rep per career pathway
Middle school business teacher from feeder school(s)
Officers: 2 co-chairs (1 business teacher, 1 business/industry) and a secretary (business teacher)

items.title: Communication with Advisory Committee
items.scope: At least 2 per year. Meeting invitations do not count. Only 1 new-member solicitation counts.

items.title: Program Needs Assessment (Survey)
items.scope: Send to at least 50 businesses; need at least 25 responses. Results shared with committee by email and in minutes. Present results as charts.
requirements: Copy of the survey and its format
Number sent and number of responses
Topics: entry-level positions, employment tests used, technical skills, software, soft skills
Results shared with committee (email and minutes)

items.title: Advisory Committee Meetings
items.scope: 2 per year. Agenda and minutes in standard format with attendance. Notes under an agenda are not minutes.
requirements: Fall 2026 and Spring 2027 (Spring held before the on-site visit)

items.title: Committee Activities
items.scope: 3 per year.
requirements: Activity, date, committee member involved, audience

items.title: Community Involvement
requirements: Activity, teacher involved, number of students involved

items.title: Employability Skills Activities
items.scope: Per course/period, 1st semester only. 3 activities = 1 pt; 4 or more = 2 pts.
requirements: 1 graded student sample with teacher feedback

items.title: Presentation Skills
items.scope: Per course/period, each semester.
requirements: Chart: topic, number of students presenting, type of visual aid
One labeled picture of a student presenting per course (period, class, presentation name)

items.title: Career Development Activities
items.scope: Per course/period, 1st semester only. At least 2 activities = 1 pt.
requirements: Assignment sheet and graded sample with feedback
Job shadow: students, grade, company, careers, student reflection
Field trips / job fairs: student reflection
Mock interviews: picture, job type, interviewer name, student reflection

items.title: Classroom Appearance
items.scope: Several labeled pictures of each classroom.
requirements: Outstanding student work on walls / bulletin boards

items.title: Program Budget
items.scope: Annual local BCS budget, per teacher if applicable.

items.title: Equipment Replacement Plan
items.scope: Replacement schedule for each BCS classroom (from CTAE director or technology staff).

items.title: Equipment & Software per Classroom
requirements: Projector / LCD, student and teacher computers
Camera / video recorder, scanner, laser printer
All software and any other teaching equipment

items.title: Shared Equipment
items.scope: List shared department equipment, or post a statement that none is shared.

items.title: Computer & Printer Specifications
requirements: Computer type, hard drive, RAM, operating system, processor

items.title: Industry Certification Grant Funds
items.scope: All grant funds accounted for by the on-site visit. Funds cannot be used for FBLA items.

items.title: Chapter Program of Work
items.scope: The chapter's own POW (not the DOE POW). Signed by chapter president, secretary, and adviser.
requirements: Header: date, school/chapter, address, advisers, chapter president
National theme, state theme, major project
Meeting plan: frequency, time, place, length, attendance and promotion
Month-by-month table (Aug to May) with activities and goal numbers
Region, State, and National conferences with dates

items.title: Monthly Chapter Meetings
items.scope: Minimum 5, virtual or face-to-face.

items.title: Elected Government Official Speaker
items.scope: Local, state, or national official (not an FBLA officer) at an FBLA meeting.
requirements: Photo with name, office, and meeting date

items.title: Region, State & National Participation
items.scope: Advisers and at least 3 students must attend in person. Registration copy (from Blue Panda) for each.
requirements: Region Leadership Conference (at least 1 competitive event)
State Leadership Conference (at least 1 competitive event)

items.title: Membership Percentage
items.scope: FBLA members / students in all BCS classes (non-duplicated). Up to 10% = 1 pt; 10.1 to 25% = 2 pts; 25.1% or more = 3 pts.

items.title: Business Achievement Awards
items.scope: 10% of membership earning BAAs this year (round up). Do not post a spreadsheet of activities.
requirements: Statement from the FBLA national office

items.title: Officer Presentation
items.scope: 3 to 5 actively involved students, student-developed, FBLA professional dress.

items.title: FBLA Points (Bonus)
items.scope: Region Officer = 1; State Officer = 3; or Chapter of the Year: Bronze 1, Silver 2, Gold 3, Superior 4.
requirements: Picture with officer title, or picture of COY plaque
